Denna position rapporterar till:
Service Operations Manager
__
Your role and responsibilities
Are you an ambitious and driven professional looking to build a successful career in project management? We are seeking an Associate Project Manager who is eager to take ownership, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and contribute to the successful delivery of projects.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead smaller projects from initiation to completion, ensuring deliverables are achieved on time, within budget, and according to agreed quality standards. You will work in a collaborative environment where learning, development, and continuous improvement are encouraged. We are looking for someone who is passionate about creating results through teamwork and who enjoys coordinating people, activities, and resources to achieve common goals.
As an Associate Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading the execution of projects with lower complexity while ensuring all activities are carried out in accordance with applicable procedures, regulations, standards, and project objectives.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Leading and coordinating the project team assigned to the project.
Monitoring and controlling project progress, resource utilization, and financial performance.
Developing and maintaining project schedules while proactively identifying and mitigating schedule risks.
Identifying, assessing, and managing project risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
Supporting effective communication and collaboration among project stakeholders.
Ensuring project deliverables meet agreed quality, scope, cost, and timeline requirements.
Driving project closure activities, including formal project acceptance, contract close-out, and customer acknowledgment in accordance with contractual requirements.
Contributing to continuous improvements in project execution and ways of working.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project and business needs.

Your background
To be successful in this role, we believe you have:
A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or another relevant field.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.
A strong interest in project management and a desire to develop as a leader.
Excellent planning, organizational, and coordination skills.
The ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders.
A proactive and results-oriented approach, with the ability to take ownership and drive tasks forward.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to adapt your message to different audiences.
A structured and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A positive attitude and a willingness to learn, grow, and contribute to a supportive team environment.

More about us
You will be part of the Ports business line within the Marine and Ports division that is specialized in advanced automation and information systems for all types of container and bulk cargo handling cranes, as well as OCR and electrical systems for container terminals. We offer an international and dynamic working environment where our business delivers advanced technology on large projects across the world in a customer oriented and highly globalized industry.

The opportunity
Do you want to work in a future-focused industry where technology meets sustainability? Do you thrive in an environment where you can grow and make a real difference?
We are looking for an enthusiastic, flexible and curious Senior Relay Engineer to join our engineering team at Grid Automation Sweden. This is an opportunity to use your protection engineering expertise in meaningful substation automation projects while helping us shape the next generation of digital solutions. If you understand IEC 61850-based systems and are motivated by turning new technology into practical, reliable ways of working, you can make a real difference in our team.
In this role, you will work with relay protection and system integration across our substation projects. You will have the freedom to bring ideas, challenge established approaches and help develop smarter and more efficient ways of working as we expand our substation capabilities. At the same time, you will grow through close collaboration with colleagues across protection, SCADA, communication and design, and become part of our world-class Hub Europe engineering community with extensive experience in delivering large and complex substation automation projects globally.
You will be part of an inclusive and innovative workplace where collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday work, and where flexible ways of working support your work–life balance.
How you will make an impact
You will be involved in developing protection and control concepts for sub-transmission systems in close collaboration with the customer along with the project core team.
You will be responsible for the configuration and testing of the relay system.
Open-minded team player that looks for opportunities instead of problems and has high standards towards safety, quality, customer focus, and efficiency.
You will openly share ideas and lessons learned with colleagues and curiously seek improvements.
Living Hitachi energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
You hold a bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent experience.
Several years of experience from Transmission and Distribution projects.
Worked with the configuration and testing of IED’s from different suppliers.
Structured and pro-active engineering approach, with a high commitment towards maintaining project budget and project plan.
For this position, professional proficiency in spoken and written English is required. Basic spoken and written Swedish skills are also required. Strong verbal and written communication skills in Swedish are considered an advantage.

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
About the Apps Platform
The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
The Role
We’re looking for software engineers with a platform mindset to work on the app runtime, deployment pipeline, and the composable managed services we purchase and operate. Some foundational services we buy from 3p partners, others are not available for purchase and you would be the first in the world to build them at scale. You'll keep these services running reliably, manage vendor relationships and migrations, and ensure operational excellence across the stack.
What You'll Do
Own the app hosting and deployment pipeline — the runtime that serves user applications in production
Manage and operate composable managed services for storage, logging, workflows etc
Build and maintain custom domains infrastructure, ensuring reliable SSL provisioning and DNS management at scale
Drive vendor evaluation, onboarding, and migration as we continue decomposing our platform from a bundled BaaS to best-of-breed individual services
Establish operational excellence practices: monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and capacity planning across all managed services

What We're Looking For
Experience building and operating distributed systems
Ideally 6+ years of experience in running and developing
Strong background in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations
Deep understanding of multitenant app hosting infrastructure, container orchestration, or edge runtimes
Vendor management experience: evaluating services, negotiating contracts, planning migrations, and holding vendors accountable for SLAs
Operational mindset: you think in uptime, latency percentiles, cost-per-request, and blast radius

Nice to Have
Experience building and operating massively multitenant control planes
Experience operating Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, or D1 at scale
Hands on experience contribution to cloud infrastructure or CNCF projects (kubernetes, worked, envoy)
Familiarity with ClickHouse or other columnar databases for log analytics
Experience with managed database services (such as Supabase, Neon, AWS Aurora, Google Cloud SQL etc)
Cost optimization experience — you've driven meaningful infrastructure cost reduction

Our tech stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Frontend: React and Typescript.
Backend: Golang and Rust.
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS.
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform.

And always on the lookout for what's next!

jobs.occupation: Process / Production Engineer to Automotive Company
jobs.description:
Do you have experience as a Process Engineer and / or as a Production Engineer and want to become a part of a world leading company? In this position you will be given the chance to join a passionate team working in a multicultural, open and dynamic environment.
ABOUT THE POSITION:
The job as Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is exciting and often rewarding, working for the benefit of the Customer Satisfaction, in contact with multiple internal and external stakeholders. We are looking for someone who has experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer who wants to take the next step in their career as a Supplier Quality Engineer.
This position belongs to the Chassis team but is in interaction with the full organisation. You will join a passionate team working in a multicultural, open and dynamic environment, eager to develop and improve with all of our stakeholders, internal and external, in order to ensure the best quality of their products.
The main focus of the team is on performance, both on supplier results and its own efficiency. Opportunities exist for the SQE to attend internal continuous improvement activities aiming for leaner working processes. From the sourcing stage up to the running production, the main tasks assigned to the Surface treatment SQE are:
To evaluate Surface Treatment (coating on Metal / Plastics ) supplier lines and facilities, managing their development plan up to the excellence level required by our customers standards.
To support the new part developments, securing the suppliers ability to coat the parts according to the specification on robust manufacturing processes.
To lead the supplier continuous improvements as well as being entitled to steer strong reaction in case of supplier performance deviation.
To contribute to the Surface Treatment Supplier Quality Global Network, working on new standard inputs, continuously improving the assessment tool and permanently monitoring the next technology and their opportunities.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
The must-haves:
Preferred Academic Degree about Surface Treatment Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering or Electrochemical Engineering, or Polymer Engineering organic and/or inorganic coating area or:
An extensive experience and strong performance in the Surface Treatment field can substitute for academic degree.
Experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer.
Has the ability to travel for work.
Are fluent in English and Swedish both spoken and written because the languages is spoken internally/externally.

The nice-to-haves:
Experience upon the Surface Treatment (coating) application processes/troubleshooting and its management within automotive business is a plus.
Good knowledge and practice of automotive quality standards and tools, such as IATF 16949, APQP-PPAP, process audit, special process audits Eg. CQI 11/12 and problem solving.

A great emphasis will be put on personal attributes where we are looking for someone that is curious, driven and has passion to be part of our clients target to shape the future of transportation and its supply chain. We also believe that you are a true team player with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with your counterparts. Furthermore, you have a quality mindset and are interested in developing suppliers; you demonstrate excellent communication skills, and you are comfortable in cross functional and multicultural set-up.
ABOUT THE ASSIGNMENT:
This is a consulting assignment which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition from the client and Friday is that the assignment will result in a permanent position.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
Employment type: Full time
Location: Gothenburg
Point of contact: Hanna Andersson
Salary: Fixed monthly salary

Apply by clicking "Sök tjänst". Remember to be quick with your application as we make continuous selection of candidates, and the position can be filled before the application deadline is due.
ABOUT FRIDAY:
At Friday, we are passionate about giving you, as a tech talent, a great start to your career. By listening to what motivates you and what you are looking for, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.
We highly value ambition and potential, and actively work towards an unbiased recruitment process where everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed.
We are located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with everything from global companies to innovative start-ups.

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join us as a Sales Manager, where you will take the lead in selling and managing complex Service Agreements and Operating & Maintenance contracts for Medium Gas Turbines to our global customers. We call it Long Term Programs (LPT). You will collaborate closely with regional sales managers and coordinate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, finance, execution, legal, and new unit sales across Siemens Energy’s global organization. From the initiation of contracts to their closure and celebration, you will play a pivotal role in this process. Are you ready to embrace this unique and challenging global sales opportunity? Apply now for the Service Agreement Sales Manager position and help us shape the future of energy!
 How You’ll Make an Impact
 You will promote, negotiate, and market Service Agreements to potential customers and Siemens Energy’s worldwide sales organizations, engaging in financial modeling, risk management, legal compliance, and technical contract negotiations.
 Strategically challenge competitors by offering innovative, tailored products and solutions that meet customer needs.
 Develop winning market strategies to enhance Siemens Energy’s competitive positioning.
 You will act independently, serving as a team leader or member in various projects.
 Act as the customer’s extended arm within the organization in Finspång.
 You will lead and actively participate in customer meetings to foster strong relationships and achieve successful outcomes.
  
What You Bring
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering and/or relevant financial or legal education.
 A minimum of 3 years of experience in sales and/or engineering of complex products, preferably gas turbines, with direct customer interaction.
 A strong interest and drive to create business solutions that meet customer needs.
 Well-developed communication and presentation skills.
 A focused, organized approach, receptive to the opinions and views of others.
 Drive, energy, persistence, and the ability to inspire those around you.
 High proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with proficiency in Swedish being a plus.
  
About the Team
We are a dynamic team of 12 members, each bringing diverse backgrounds and extensive experience in selling Long Term Programs. As we anticipate growth and prioritize proactive succession planning, we are eager to welcome new team members who can contribute to our success.
 Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Defence and security are changing fast. At Saab Naval Combat Systems, we are investing for growth and adapting to this shift. To succeed, we need to maintain focus and cohesion at system level across the solutions we deliver to our customers.
As Head of Systems Design, you will lead a department of highly skilled specialists within Technical Project Management, Systems Engineering, Configuration Management and Safety Engineering. The department is responsible for overall system design, ensuring that architecture, requirements and technical solutions are managed throughout the product lifecycle.
The organization currently consists of seven managers and their teams. You will also have a dotted-line responsibility for a team in Germany, playing a key role in strengthening collaboration and harmonizing ways of working across our Swedish and German operations. As a member of the Product Unit management team, you report to the Head of PU Combat Systems.
Your main task will be to initiate and drive a transformation journey for our Systems Design department. Today, we have many parallel projects and a strong delivery focus, but we see great potential to work more efficiently and strategically product oriented. 
Key responsibilities:
Lead, coach and develop seven line managers and their teams.
Set the strategic direction for Systems Design and translate it into clear priorities and actions.
Drive increased reuse of designs, architectures and technical solutions across projects.
Establish common processes, methods and tools within Systems Engineering, Configuration Management, Safety Engineering and Technical Project Management.
Strengthen ownership of engineering processes, methods and tools within the line organization.
Improve onboarding and knowledge sharing to reduce dependency on key individuals and accelerate productivity.
Ensure consistency and quality in the application of methods, tools and processes across projects.
Balance operational delivery with long-term capability development by acting as a bridge between projects and the line organization.
Strengthen collaboration and leverage synergies across our Swedish, German, Finnish and Australian operations.
Contribute actively to the Engineering Management Team through strategic planning, competence development and resource management.

Your profile

As a person, you are clear, trustworthy and engaging. You create participation, set direction and dare to challenge established ways of working - always with the business, the customer and your people in focus.
We believe you have:
Solid experience from systems development in a complex, regulated or safety-critical environment.
Proven leadership experience, preferably with responsibility for managers and senior experts.
Experience of driving change and improvement work in engineering organisations, for example around process development, reuse/standardisation or CM.
An understanding for or experience with running large and complex projects.
A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to see the big picture and at the same time understand operational challenges.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both spoken and written. Knowledge of Swedish and/or German is an advantage but not a requirement.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

Join our Technology Development team in Svedala and help develop simulation models that improve the performance of our crushing solutions. In this position, you combine analytical work with hands-on verification and testing, while building a detailed understanding of our machine systems and their functionality.  
About your job
As a CAE Engineer, you design, implement and use simulation models to support the development and optimization of our machine systems. Your work ranges from physical modelling and analysis to practical model verification, testing and measurement activities, with close connections to product development.  
Job responsibilities  
Design, implement and use simulation models across different physical domains.  
Develop functionality that supports the design, optimization and improvement of machine systems. 
Verify and validate simulation models through testing and measurement activities. 
Develop algorithms and code related to simulation and modelling.  
Collaborate with design engineers on product improvements and new concepts. 
Contribute to developing our CAE methods, tools and ways of working. 

 
Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Svedala, where Division Crushing Solutions has its global development center for crushers.
Your profile
We’re looking for someone with a strong technical and analytical foundation and an interest in physical modelling and simulation. Experience in developing and validating simulation models enables you to move confidently between theoretical analysis and practical verification.  
Your background includes 
A Master of Science or higher degree in physics, mathematics or mechanical engineering.  
Experience developing simulation models in different physical domains.  
Experience verifying and validating simulation models. 
Experience in algorithm development and coding.  
It’s beneficial if you have experience in testing, as well as experience leading projects or teams.  

You enjoy working with new technology and approaching complex challenges in a structured, analytical and pragmatic way. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and your communication skills help you work effectively across functions, cultures and with both internal and external stakeholders. Just as importantly, you contribute to a positive team spirit.  
The team
You join a small and agile Technology Development team, giving you the opportunity to influence methods, tools and ways of working within CAE. Cross-functional collaboration is a natural part of your day, connecting you with colleagues and stakeholders across our organization.
Our culture
Sandvik is so much more than an engineering group in the manufacturing industry. We’re a global company with many opportunities for personal and professional development – and great benefits. We’ve been an employer to trust for 160 years, and our reward philosophy states that remuneration and other employment conditions should align with local market practice, be competitive, and reflect responsibility and performance. We have a clear objective of being a leader within digital solutions in our industry and we focus on growing our digital customer offering. To get there, we work towards an even more diverse and inclusive organization – because we’re sure that differences improve Sandvik's business and creates a culture of innovation.

This is a senior leadership position with overall responsibility for Quality across our Swedish operations. The role reports directly to the Managing Director Sweden and is a member of the Swedish Management Team.
The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on understanding of manufacturing, customer requirements, process quality and continuous improvement.
The Role
As Country Quality Manager, you will lead the Swedish Quality organization and drive the continued development of quality performance across our operations.
Your responsibility covers Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality, with a strong focus on robust processes, preventive quality and continuous improvement.
You will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, Supply Chain and Production Development, as well as with the Quality Management System organization.
A key part of the role is to strengthen quality ownership throughout the organization and ensure that quality is built into our processes.
You will represent Quality in the Swedish Management Team and act as a senior quality interface with customers, suppliers and the wider Gnutti Carlo Group.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Quality organization and quality agenda in Sweden.

Develop the capabilities and ways of working within Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality.

Drive Customer Quality, including customer relationships, claims, structured problem solving, corrective actions and effectiveness verification.

Strengthen Quality Assurance and Process Quality, including quality gates, control plans, process controls and verification methods.

Drive preventive quality, process capability and manufacturing robustness in close cooperation with Operations and Engineering.

Ensure effective application of automotive quality methods including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strengthen Quality involvement in new products, process changes, industrialization and production launches.

Lead and develop Supplier Quality together with Purchasing and Engineering, focusing on supplier performance and preventive quality development.

Drive reduction of customer claims, internal defects, scrap, rework and Cost of Poor Quality through structured problem solving, lessons learned and sustainable corrective actions.

Establish and follow clear quality KPIs, priorities and management routines, strengthening quality ownership and accountability throughout the organization.

Work closely with the Quality Management System organization to ensure alignment between system requirements and operational execution.

Lead and support the Quality organization, ensuring structured processes, fact-based analysis and effective actions.

Your Profile
We are looking for an experienced quality leader with a strong background in the automotive industry.
You understand quality from both a technical and leadership perspective and are comfortable working close to manufacturing while maintaining the broader perspective required for a country-level management position.
We believe you have:

Several years of leadership experience within Quality in the automotive industry.

Experience as a senior Quality Manager, Plant Quality Manager, Quality Director or equivalent.

Strong knowledge of automotive quality requirements and IATF 16949.

Solid experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strong experience in Customer Quality, Supplier Quality and structured problem solving.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, process capability and preventive quality.

Experience in leading and developing teams in an international manufacturing environment.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate quality data into priorities and actions.

Fluent English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Leadership Profile
We are looking for a leader who is visible in the operation, understands manufacturing reality and is comfortable moving between management-level discussions, customer interaction and the factory floor.
You are structured, fact-based and pragmatic. You create clear ownership and expectations, challenge existing ways of working and follow through until actions deliver the intended result.
Most importantly, you understand that sustainable quality performance is built through strong processes, technical understanding, prevention, clear ownership and disciplined execution.
What We Offer
This position offers the opportunity to take a central role in the continued development of Quality within Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden.
As Country Quality Manager, you will have a strong mandate to influence the Quality organization, our ways of working and the long-term development of quality performance across our Swedish operations.
You will work closely with the Managing Director, the Swedish Management Team and key functions across the organization, while interacting with customers, suppliers and the wider Gnutti Carlo Group

We are now looking for an R&D Senior Engineer to join our MACH R&D organization within HVDC. In this role, you will contribute to the development of one of the world's most advanced control and protection platforms for power transmission systems.

As part of our global R&D organization, you will work closely with colleagues in Sweden and India to develop next-generation embedded solutions for HVDC systems. How you'll make an impact

Your background

Several years of experience in embedded software development within complex industrial, real-time, or mission-critical systems.
Strong programming skills in C/C++ and solid experience with embedded systems architecture and real-time operating systems.

About the role

jobs.occupation: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
jobs.description:
Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.
Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.
We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.
What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.
Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:
Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.
Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.
Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.

Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.
Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.
Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.
Required qualificationsThe position requires:
PhD in Biology or Bioengineering
Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories
At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal 
Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels
Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification
Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D
Experience in microfluidics and microscopy
Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Merits include:
Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation
Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.
Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software
Experience as executive member of scientific societies 

Terms of employment
This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.
The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.
Application instructionsYour application should include:
A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans
A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors
A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)
A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)

We warmly welcome your application!
Mer om Medicinska fakulteten
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.
Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments

Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch         
 
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive salary, Pension plans, health insurance, and other benefits according to the collective bargin.

Employee discounts on Bosch products.

We are looking for a researcher in Psychology for a fixed-term position at the School of Behavioral, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR). The research is within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Psychology.
Background
The Division of Psychology at Örebro University is part of the School of Behavioural, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR), together with the Divisions of Legal Science, Criminology, and Social Work.
Örebro university is now hiring a researcher within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging, with a particular focus on early life predictors of brain structural and functional connectivity in older age. The research will be conducted within the research environment LEADER (Center for Lifespan Developmental Research), which is headed by Jonas Persson, Professor in Psychology.
Duties and responsibilities
The research duties include preprocessing and analyses of structural and functional brain imaging data obtained by magnetic resonance imaging. A particular focus will be on analysing diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) data to assess structural connectivity and brain network properties in older age and how these related to health, cognition, lifestyle and other factors in childhood and adolescence. Analyses of functional connectivity data from resting-state fMRI images and the relationship with early life predictors is also expected. The applicant will also have a leading role in dissemination of the results through international peer-reviewed publication and presentations.  
Qualifications
Those qualified for the appointment as a researcher are applicants who have obtained a doctoral degree or have a degree from abroad deemed to correspond to a doctoral degree.
Assessment criteria
A general basis for assessment is that the applicant is able to demonstrate the personal qualities required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities at hand; that they are able to cooperate with other members of staff; and contribute to the development of university operations.
Specific personal abilities that are of great importance for the position is documented expertise in the fields of cognitive aging and brain imaging. Of particular importance is proficiency in analysing structural brain connectivity data, connectome-based modelling and tractography of diffusion-tensor imaging (DTI)/DWI data combined with a documented ability in analysing functional MRI data. Experience of working with longitudinal MRI data is also highly desirable, along with experience in working with software such as Matlab, R and SPM.
Information
This is a fixed-term full-time position for 12 months. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.
For more information about the position, contact Jonas Persson +46 19 301428, email: jonas.persson@oru.se, or Head of Unit Terese Glatz, +46 19 301205, email: terese.glatz@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Application
The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.
For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:
Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
Account of research qualifications and experience
Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.
 More information for applicants will be found on our career site:  https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/
The application deadline is November 27, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application!

We are looking for a new Lead Technician based at our site in Cloud, Overturingen!
A Snapshot of Your Day
As our Lead Technician, you will be responsible for the daily leadership and supervision of service technicians, ensuring efficient planning and execution of service, operations, and warranty activities for turbines within your service area. You will build a long-term perspective with the team to ensure that Siemens Gamesa consistently delivers high performance and value to our customers.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Perform tasks delegated by the responsible Operations Manager.
Coordinate, plan, and execute service, operational, and support activities for the assigned site or travelling technician team, including resource planning, vacation scheduling, and work rosters in collaboration with central planning.
Ensure that safety is always the top priority, and that all technicians have the required training, safety equipment, work instructions, and risk assessments before commencing any work.
Continuously follow up on incidents and drive improvements by implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.
Ensure that site personnel and subcontractors are informed of and comply with agreed EHS procedures and the site-specific EHS plan.
Utilize local and regional technical support resources to resolve technical issues on site.
Take corrective actions, address deficiencies, and drive continuous improvements within the service teams.
Be responsible for the ongoing development and improvement of productivity, KPIs, and other site and contract objectives, supported by the Operations Manager.
Provide monthly reporting to customers and lead monthly customer meetings with support from the Operations Manager.
Build long-term relationships with customers as the primary site contact and collaborate closely with suppliers to establish lasting partnerships.
Manage operations under varying conditions and adjust work and resource planning to meet contractual obligations, optimize wind farm performance, and maximize team productivity.
Lead the team in maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation and records.
Handle site administration, including reporting, order management, record keeping, and related administrative responsibilities. 

What You Bring
A passion for renewable energy and a commitment to driving the energy transition.
The ideal candidate has a technical or vocational education, preferably with an electrical and/or mechanical background and relevant experience. You have several years of experience in a leadership, supervisory, or team lead role.
In addition, you will:
Demonstrate excellent planning and organizational skills.
Have a technical background in electrical, mechanical, or hydraulic systems.
Possess experience as a supervisor, team leader, or similar.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment and preferably have experience within the wind energy sector.
Be able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken. Swedish is considered a significant advantage.
Hold a valid Category B driving licence.
Be physically fit and comfortable working at heights. A medical examination is required, including the Swedish “Mast and Pole Certificate” (Mast- och Stolpintyg).

Please note that if offered the position, you will be required to successfully complete a medical examination and a drug and alcohol test before commencing employment.
 
Who is Siemens Energy?
Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning more than 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
As a leading player in the wind power industry and a manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and delivering innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demands of communities worldwide. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for talented individuals who want to join our journey and contribute to the transformation of the global energy landscape.

Our Commitment to Diversity
Fortunately, we are all different. Through diversity, we generate power.
Our success is driven by inclusion, and our collective creative energy comes from approximately 130 nationalities. At Siemens Energy, we embrace diversity in all its forms and do not discriminate based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, disability, or any other characteristic. We energize society as a whole, and we believe that our differences make us stronger.

jobs.description:
System Tester – Pro Robotic R&D – Husqvarna Group
Want to help shape the future of professional robotic lawn care? Join our Pro Robotic R&D team and work hands-on with robotic mowers used in demanding professional environments.
Our team develops and maintains robotic mower solutions for customers such as football clubs, parks, commercial properties and golf courses. Reliability, efficiency and consistent performance are essential, and that is where our System Test team comes in.

As a System Tester, you will be part of the System and Test team, verifying system behaviour, functionality and overall product quality.

Role Description
This is a hands-on role where you will test our robotic products in real field environments, simulated and lab environments, as well as through automated test pipelines. You will work closely with system engineers, software and product development teams, and other test functions to understand how the complete system performs. Your responsibilities will include:
Verifying new functionality and bug fixes in field and lab environments
Performing regression and acceptance testing
Identifying, analysing and documenting deviations from requirements
Tracking test progress and ensuring coverage against requirements
Contributing to improved test methods, workflows and ways of working

The exact focus of the role can be adapted based on your previous experience, technical strengths and areas where you want to continue developing.
You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.

Your profile
You are curious, structured and quality-minded, with a genuine interest in understanding how technology works in practice. You enjoy combining hands-on testing with analysis and problem-solving. Furthermore, take ownership of your work, know how to prioritise and enjoy collaborating across different engineering disciplines in a dynamic R&D environment.
We believe you have:
At least 2 years of experience testing embedded products
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Software Development, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a related field
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus
A Swedish B driving licence
The possibility to travel

It’s a plus if you also have experience in:
System-level test automation
Data analytics
Linux and/or ROS
Electrical load testing
Jira or Azure DevOps
ISTQB or a similar software testing certification

Location
The role is based on-site in Huskvarna, combined with travel related to testing at field locations. You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.
We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:
Hiring Manager: Tim Hartelius Tim.Hartelius@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina, Gorjana.Dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

jobs.occupation: Head of Product Line – Fire Detection, Building & Rolling Stock
jobs.description:
About Consilium At Consilium Safety Group, we don’t just build technology — we create solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries including marine, energy, rolling stock, and infrastructure.
With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and operating in over 55 locations worldwide, Consilium is a fast-growing global organization backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are on an ambitious journey of growth and transformation — investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent.
This is an exciting time to join us.

The Role
As Head of Product Line – Fire Detection, Building & Rolling Stock, you will hold strategic responsibility for a key part of Consilium's portfolio, driving innovation, business alignment, and long-term growth.
You will lead the development and execution of a forward-looking product strategy that supports our business objectives and strengthens our position in the global safety market. Managing a global team of Product Managers and Product Specialists, you will foster collaboration across regions and functions while building a strong "One Consilium" culture.
You will own the full product lifecycle, from roadmap and portfolio management through to market positioning and business performance. Working closely with R&D, Operations, Sales, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure our solutions meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and the highest performance and safety standards.
You will also play a central role in identifying new business opportunities, driving profitable growth, and ensuring strategic initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the product line strategy for Fire detection, Building and Rolling Stock solutions

Lead, develop, and grow a global team of Product Managers and Product specialists

Own portfolio management, product lifecycle planning, and roadmap prioritization

Partner with R&D and Technical leadership to maximize business value and ROI from development investment

Identify market trends, customer needs, and new growth opportunities

Support the commercial organization in hitting sales and profitability targets

Optimize pricing strategies, margins, and product positioning

Ensure accurate forecasting, reporting, and data-driven decision-making

Represent Consilium in customer meetings, industry forums, and strategic partnerships

Champion cross-functional collaboration and a strong global team culture

Your Profile
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader with a passion for technology, innovation, and safety. 
You likely have:

A university degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, or equivalent experience

Proven experience in a technology industry with regulated, safety-critical products. Direct exposure to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock is a strong advantage

Proven experience within the safety technology industry, ideally related to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock

Strong leadership experience, including leading and motivating international teams

A solid understanding of product management, product lifecycle processes, and business-driven product development

Experience working in global and cross-cultural environments

Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, profitability, and growth targets

Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills

Experience with agile development methodologies is considered a strong advantage

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and inspiring leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach. You are comfortable navigating complex global environments and enjoy building strong relationships across functions and markets.

What We Offer
At Consilium, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact in a global company at the forefront of safety innovation.
We offer:

A key leadership role with global influence

The opportunity to shape the future of safety technology

A collaborative and international work environment

A culture driven by innovation, responsibility, and continuous improvement

Competitive compensation and benefits

Opportunities for professional and personal growth

Ready to Make an Impact?
If this sounds like your next challenge, we would love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of a company committed to innovation, safety, and sustainable global growth.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
